Well hello guys!
Today we are releasing the version 1.0 of Giant Life, a VR physic puzzle game.
Play as an angry giant through a virtual reality journey, exploring the realm, destroying settlements and frightening its inhabitants.

[h1][b]Main features:[/b][/h1]

[*] 5 special throwable projectiles.
[*] 22 unique levels.
[*] More than 50 destructible structures.

[*] Cute low poly graphics.

notes.title: Gates Motel - Our new horror game!
notes.notes:
Well guys, it has been a couple of weeks of resting, playing and testing Pixel Survivors, just for the fun of it. 
But now we've decided to present our new horror tittle on Steam Greenlight.
So far it made it to the top #100 of the ranking.
We would like you guys, those who followed us for almost 2 years, to share your thoughts and vote for it if you would like to see it on Steam.

What's the game about?
The game puts players in a motel off the main road, where they will play as a woman who has to confront two kinds of nightmares: The owner of the establishment as well as her own, deep, dark fears. Your job is to avoid the same fate previous tenants had to suffer while making your way to the telephone to notify local authorities and be rescued. 

A playable demo of the game will be available in the upcoming weeks. 

Help us get through the Steam Greenlight!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=679195706no

Thanks you!

[h1]<EDIT>[/h1]

[b] The game was greenlit! Thank you very much to everybody who voted![/b] 

The Patagoniart Team.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.08 - FULL RELEASE + HOTFIX!
notes.notes:
Well guys, the day has come. Today, after almost 2 years of development we are leaving Early Access. 
We have learned a lot this past year on Steam, and we loved to interact with the community as the game improved over the months.
It took over 50 patches and major updates to get the game where it is right now. We've tried to improve what you guys think needed polishing for this patch, as well as adding new structures and a finalle to the game.

[img]http://oi68.tinypic.com/imrpg0.jpg[/img]

Without further rambling here are the patch notes:

[h1]VERSION 1.0:[/h1] [list]
[*]Added intermitent red blink warning to the some important resources in the top tab.
[*]Redesigned the main code of the game. Higher performance improvements on lower cpus. 
[*]Added animation to the chicken pen.
[*]Major improvements to the task assigments of the villagers. 
(Important to keep in mind that villagers can only do so much per day. If you have plenty of things to be done, but not enough villagers, most likely they will get overwhelmed)
[*]Fixed bugs in the library system.
[*]Fixed bugs in the boat system.
[*]Fixed bugs related to interface drawings.
[*]Fixed bugs in the pathfinding of the sick population.
[*]Fixed bug in the soldier pathfinding.
[*]Fixed glitch in the fish spawning system.
[*]Fixed minor bugs scavenged around the game.
[*]Added end game structure: The Portal. This structure will allow the villagers to leave the game realm.
[*]Added victory and defeat to each game, showing a new interface with produced stats and saved villagers.
[*]Added roads, just as a decoration structure. Trees won't be placed on this tile. Don't place it on reforesting zones.
[*]Replaced the 1000 population achievement with the game ending achievement.
[/list]

[h1]VERSION 1.08:[/h1] 
[list]
[*]Fixed crash when training soldiers.
[*]Fixed ocasional crash with the tailor.
[*]Fixed typos in the tutorial.
[*]Fixed small bugs in the tutorial.
[*]Fixed pinewood tree glitch.
[*]Fixed villagers glitching into constructions.
[*]Fixed bug setting achievements incorrectly.
[/list]

Hope you guys enjoy it, and thanks to those who helped us improve the game!
We will keep working on polishing the game. 
And, as usual, if you find any bugs, leave them in the "Bug Report" Section in the Community Hub! 
To read the update history, go to: 
http://steamcommunity.com/app/342970/discussions/4/ 


The Patagoniart Team.

notes.title: FULL RELEASE - COMING SOON!
notes.notes:
Well guys, we've been working like maniacs the past few weeks:
Polishing game mechanics here and there.
Fixing bugs like there is no tomorrow.
Adding the final end game structures.
Making animations and interfaces.
Redoing the tutorial.
Polishing the pathfinding.
We will add some videotutorials if you have any doubts if you are new to the game

We are pretty satisfied with testing of our Beta testers, and we want to thank them for doing an amazing job at finding bugs and glitches.

So the team gathered yesterday and we've finally have a release date:
[u] [b] Thursday 5th of May. (05/05/2016)[/b] [/u] 

We will keep working in the game adding small things and always keeping an eye out in the forums to listen to you guys.
We feel it's time to move on with new projects. It has been an amazing two years since the pre-alpha build in Desura until now, a complete game.

We will keep the price at USD 3,99 so more players can have access to it and enjoy it, since it was our goal from the get go: Let the people enjoy our game!

Thank you guys for all the Early Access feedback and love.

[u] [b] The Patagoniart Team.[/b] [/u]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.73 - STRUCTURES, STRUCTURES AND MORE STRUCTURES!
notes.notes:
Well guys, it has been a couple weeks since our last beta patch, and finally we've got it working.
Plenty of new structures were added to the game, as well as general bug fixing and polishment to the beta build.
The beta testers are doing a great job so far finding bugs and helping us solve them. We will keep on realising unique content for the testers, as time goes by.
Without further rambling here is what we've added for the new Update:

[img]http://i68.tinypic.com/2rf5xd5.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*]NEW STRUCTURE: Church. Will rise the Mana capacity by 100, boost the mana regain and defend the village of the undead on the red perimeter. Requires learning Ocultism I.
[*]NEW STRUCTURE: Flooding Tank. Will flood a small pond where villager will be able to grow and harvest new types of crops. Requires learning Agriculture II.
[*]NEW CROP: Rice. Can be planted in the small pond the Flooding Tank creates. (+food) 
[*]NEW CROP: Jute. Can be planted in the small pond the Flooding Tank creates. (+fabric)
[*]NEW STRUCTURE: Townhall. Same as the library when interacting with this structure a new UI will pop showing production and consumption rates.
[*]NEW CHALLENGE: Sickness. The villagers now are susceptible to getting sick when interacting with crops and chicken. Keeping a good stock of medicine will prevent a massive contagion outbreak.
[*]Improved and polished the help interface.
[*]Fixed many minor bugs.
[/list]

This patch is pretty stable now. We will keep on fixing bugs as they appear. 
There is only one more structure to be added to the game, that will be revealed once we transition into the full release. Also will polish up and remake the tutorial for a better learning curve.

Hope you guys enjoy it! 
And, as usual, if you find any bugs, leave them in the "Bug Report" Section in the Community Hub!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.72 - THE LIBRARY!
notes.notes:
Well guys, we finally were able to finish the hierarchy tree and add the library  (Structure picked by you guys a few months back) to the game, as well as some other interface improvements, new types of trees.
So far we've handpicked 15 people to beta test Pixel Survivors and receive some extra features in game.
If you would like to apply, we will take another 15 batch in the upcoming weeks.
[b]Contact us to: patagoniartgs@gmail.com[/b]

[img]http://oi67.tinypic.com/jrr47o.jpg[/img]

Without futher to say, here is the first Beta Build available in Early Access:
[list]
[*]Improved the GUI.  
[*]Added new structure: The Library.
[*]Added new trees: Willow tree and Birch tree. (Learning required)
[*]Added small interaction buttons with buildings on right click.
[*]Added books to be learned in the library. These learned books will allow the creation of new structures and improvements to the village (Upgrade system)
[*]Boats will only be created if there is a dock constructed.
[*]The mana regain was lowered.
[*]Bug fixed: Plants not being harvested when food at max capacity.
[/list]

[h1]Library system:[/h1]
25 books are now available for learning. This learning curve will grant access to new structures, efficiency and improvements for the village.
Until the next patch the only cost of the books will be the time it takes to learn them. So you guys can get familiarized with the system.

[h1]Book Genres:[/h1]

notes.notes:
Well guys, it has been a long working couple of weeks, but we've finally finished the 0.65 Patch. We've changed plenty of stuff for the mid/late game as well as some new additions and menues re-organization:
[img]http://oi63.tinypic.com/6jem1c.jpg[/img]
[h1] 0.65	[/h1]
[list]
[*]Bug Fixed: Loading easy or hard difficulty will save the current initial storage capacity. 
[*]Bug Fixed: Chicken pens butchering without tools. 
[*]Bug Fixed: Villagers getting stuck colliding with carts and barns when carrying chickens to the pens.
[*]New mining system. Will balance a bit more the mid/late game. 
[*]Reorganized the menues, now we've got plenty of room for the upcoming new structures!
[*]Added spoilage to perishible resources.
[*]New structure: The root cellar. This building works pretty much like a barn.
Villager will be able to use root cellars to preserve perishible resources. They will use barns if the root cellars capacity is full, but those resources will spoil over time.
[*]Added double pathfinding to villagers. If they are carrying resources that belong in different storages, they will do one first, and then the other.

Well guys, this is the 0.64 update. We've focused on clearing more and more minor bugs, as well as adding some features for those players who stick a little while in-game and manage to get medium and large size village. So here we go again:
[img]http://oi67.tinypic.com/2u8v1hw.jpg[/img]
[h1] UPDATE 0.64[/h1]
[list]
[*]Bug Fixed: Boats stuck in the menus. 
[*]Bug Fixed: Boats stuck in land will break. (This happened when creating new land on top a boat) 
[*]Bug Fixed: Requirements for the tailor shop has been corrected.
[*]Bug Fixed: Small glitches in the transportation of resources.
[*]Added new STRUCTURE: The Sawmill. The nearby cut trees, will go there to be processed. Improving the production by two. (Similar mechanic as the Windmill.)
[*]Added radius of working distance to the foresting tower.
[*]The starting butchering level was set to 5 by default, hope that might help people figure out it works. 
[/list]
[h1] UPDATE 0.64.4[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added the new Logo to the main menu.
[*]Bug Fixed: Saplings planted on top of sawmills.
[*]Bug Fixed: Radius of the foresting tower. (It affects the chunk, not the particular tree location)
[*]Bug Fixed: Trees outside the sawmill radius not being harvested.
[/list]
Next patch we will be focusing on re-organizing the Menus in the user interface. a
Hope you guys enjoy, and discover how to improve the wood production in the mid-late game. 
And, as usual, if you find any bugs, leave them in the "Bug Report" Section in the Community Hub!
To read the update history, go to:   
[url]http://steamcommunity.com/app/342970/discussions/4/[/url]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.57.4 - BUILD AND DESTROY! (Patch)
notes.notes:
Well guys, it has been a good working week.
This update is about the structures, and how villagers and the enviroment interact with them. So here we go again with the improvements:

[list]
[*] Adjusted the heatlh stat on top of the citizens
[*] Buildings will be now constructed by stages and need villager interaction, each stage taking a certain amount of time. 
[*] Houses will now host villagers during the night. (Only workers, the soldiers will stay patrolling in the fields.)
[*] If your city has undeads, they might catch the roaming villagers at dusk. 
Else, they'll try to destroy the villagers houses and get them.
[*] Houses will be repaired in the morning, if the village has enough resources to do it.
[*] If you hover your mouse on top of each house, it will display the integrity of the building.
[*] If you upgrade your houses, they will resist better the night sieges.
[/list]

[b]Patch 0.57.3[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the time the zombies can survive the daytime (Will die at break of down, will need feedback on how that affect the very late game - 300-400 undeads)
[*] Villagers will sleep at night, not EAT!
[*] Patched the AI, to keep the task organized. Food first. Cloth second. Other task third.
[/list]

[b]Patch 0.57.4[/b]

[list]
[*] Recoded the pathfinding AI, now, villagers should not get stuck anymore..
[*] Added randomness to the job assigments.
[*] Removed the hide at night feature, until I can find a better elegant solution for it.

[/list]
Hope that fixed most of the reported bugs of this build.



Hope you guys enjoy it.
And if you find any bugs, leave them in the "Bug Report" Section in the Community Hub!
To read the update history, go to:   
[url]http://steamcommunity.com/app/342970/discussions/4/[url/]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.47.5 - VILLAGER AI (Patched)
notes.notes:
Well guys, it's been a while, and I'm finally back home, and ready to get the game improved. During this absense I've took the time to look at your guys request, and noticed it usually was related to get the villagers a bit smarter.
So here it is:

- Villagers will now propperly pathfind toward fields (Barley, Wheat, Herbs and Worm fields), when they are ready for planting and harvesting.
- They will also take they'r own personal health into consideration, so if they are hungry or cold, they will try to find the closest source of food or clothing.
- Also fixed some minor graphical glitches.

Patch 0.47.5:

- Villagers will now be able to walk through buildings. (Later on will add enterting from one side, and coming out of the other one.)
- Main buildings will produce resources at different rates (The more population you have the faster resources will gather.)
- Values and ratios will change depending on your reactions, so help us get a balance in the game.
- Fixed wheat fields not being aligned to the grid.

I will keep on working on the interaction of the villagers with the player and the town itself. 

Hope you guys enjoy it, and as usual leave the Bugs you can find in the bug report section!

Sachonski

notes.notes:
Well guys here it is. The undead update:

- New building: The armory, it will let your villagers create weapons as well as becoming soldiers if you tell them so.
- Life stats now show on top of each villagers if you hover the mouse over them.
- Mines: Hover with the mouse on top of a mine to see how many resources it has left.
- Improved and updated the help interface. (Is not much, but the next update will be a total GUI revamp)
- New type of citizen: Soldier. Fierce and brave man/woman, who will defend against intruders at all cost.
- Re-introduced the day-night cycle: 5 mins day, 1 min night.
- THE UNDEAD: As your villagers die of age, hunger, or sickness, they will become part of the undead. These undead will spawn at night in the lands you've created and try to kill the citizens. That is when you'll have to find a small balance between soldiers and villagers, so you won't starve to death, neither die eaten by undeads. Undead will die once morning come and come back next night. 


In future updates you'll be able to reduce the amount of undeads by adding holy structures and cemeterys. The next part of the development plan is to add seasons, then a revamp of the GUI, and start adding structures left and right.

Hope you guys enjoy the update. And as usual leave the bugs you find in the bug reports section.

Sachonski.

=D

Sachonski

notes.title: DEVELOPMENT PLAN
notes.notes:
DEVELOPMENT PLAN:

Well guys, the game is going quite well, slowly but surely I think I'm gaining my keep around here. So I came up with a development plan for the game, making Survivors one of a kind game.
Lets start from where we are right now:

- You can create some land.
- Add some buildings.
- Upgrade them.
- Pray it will be enough fun to keep you out of your troubles.

That being said, lets get to the DEV PLAN:

As it is right now, your villagers can deforest and destroy the land around them pretty quick. But that will change, I'll try my best to develop a tool system, where villagers will be able to craft  tools, use them, and in rare (not so rare) occasions, break them. For that you will require to mine iron and coal. Then build a forge (new building), and then that raw resources will end up being stock in a tool-smith store (new building), and in a weapon-smith store (new building)

Then the fun part: With the weapon-smith store you'll be able to create weapons, to defend yourself... From who? From yourself...

...

What? Yes, every citizen that dies in game, will come back during the nights as zombie, ghoul, or skelly, haven't decide it yet (Suggestions are appreciated). You will be able to reduce the amount of undead by adding cemeterys and sanctuarys. So there you have two troubles to deal with, attacks during nights, and starvation during day. Well lets add a third one, is the charm, right? How about season. (To start off, summer and winter), so your villagers can also die of freezing. Then you would have to create a tailor shop (new building), and use the chicken feather's to make nice and cosy vest for your beloved citizens.

So there you go guys, you've wondered why the game was called Survivors, that's why, I just didn't know if I could accomplish all of that in a short period of time. 
So resuming, whats coming:

- Forges.
- Mines with coal, stone and iron.
- Tool-smith's shops.
- Weapon-smith's shops.
- Barracks/Training camps (to create soldiers and defend at night, probably all civilians will go home and the soldiers will remain on watch)
- Tailor's shop.
- Cemetery.
- Sanctuary.
- Soldiers.
- More crops.
- Lights.
- More wild animals.

According to the UI, I'll try to improve as I can, slowly but surely.
Guys, please keep in mind that I cannot do this as a full time job, but I'll try my best to make it as quick as possible.

Thank you guys for the patience, and join me to create an epic indie game we all could be proud of.



		Sachonski, Survivors Dev.
